summary.name: Medallia
summary.one_liner: Medallia is an experience management software platform for customer, contact center, employee and digital experience, with AI tools for replies, theme detection, driver analysis and summaries of text feedback.
use_cases: analyzing customer feedback at enterprise scale
generating personalized replies to customer feedback
finding emerging themes in survey text
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Medallia as a platform for turning experience data into business impact, with stated claims about cost savings and revenue growth. It lists AI tools that generate personalized, branded replies to close the loop on feedback. It also claims automatic theme detection across text analytics without manual tagging, and driver analysis that surfaces drivers without an analyst. A further feature turns unstructured text into summaries. The page cites customer figures such as 185% three-year ROI and $30M growth from personalization, but these are vendor-reported.
notable: AI-generated, branded replies to close the loop on feedback
Automatic theme detection across text analytics with no manual tagging
AI driver analysis without requiring an analyst
Named in The Forrester Wave: Customer Feedback Management and Analytics Solutions, Q3 2026
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; ROI and savings figures are vendor claims without methodology
Pricing is not stated on the page; it directs visitors to contact an expert
Listing refers to MonkeyLearn, but the page content is Medallia's enterprise platform, so the URL and page may have changed
